title: Beyond "ChatGPT Can Make Mistakes": Designing Interventions to Support Metacognitive Monitoring in AI-Assisted Work
abstract: arXiv:2609.17065v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI assistance places a metacognitive demand on users, who must judge their own competence and the system's. Yet designers lack comparative evidence on which interventions to choose, where to place them, and how to tell whether they worked. We elicited 30 interventions from 11 experts and, with prior work, organized them into a design space of time (when an intervention acts), level (whose competence is judged), and source (who supplies the monitoring cue). A between-subjects experiment (N = 917; 12 planning-and-organizing problems) compared a per-task reliability card, contrasting replies, pause points, and post-problem reflection against a baseline LLM assistant. Reliability cards and contrasting replies reduced estimation error and overconfidence and increased aggregate confidence discrimination. translated_title: 超越“ChatGPT会犯错”：设计干预措施以支持AI辅助工作中的元认知监控
translated_abstract: AI辅助对用户提出了元认知要求，用户必须同时判断自身能力和系统能力。然而，设计者在选择何种干预措施、将其放置在何处以及如何判断其是否有效方面缺乏比较性证据。我们从11位专家那里收集了30种干预措施，并结合先前的工作，将其组织成一个包含时间（干预何时起作用）、层级（判断谁的能力）和来源（谁提供监控线索）三个维度的设计空间。一项被试间实验（N=917；12个规划与组织问题）将每任务可靠性卡片、对比回复、暂停点和问题后反思与基线LLM助手进行了比较。结果显示，可靠性卡片和对比回复减少了估计误差和过度自信，并提高了总体信心辨别力，但未发现任务表现的改善或平均项目内辨别力的提升。我们贡献了一套共享词汇、一个设计空间以及关于哪些干预措施有效的实证证据。
tldr: 本研究构建了AI辅助工作中元认知监控干预措施的设计空间，并通过917人的实验发现可靠性卡片和对比回复能有效减少用户的估计误差和过度自信、提升信心辨别力。
en_tdlr: This study constructs a design space for metacognitive monitoring interventions in AI-assisted work and, through an experiment with 917 participants, finds that reliability cards and contrasting replies effectively reduce estimation errors and overconfidence while improving confidence discrimination.
